headline: Approved fee waivers for two youth sports groups and a court rental request, all by 3-0 votes.
summary: The commission approved June meeting minutes, financial reports, and division reports. It approved a partial fee waiver for the Charlestown Cowboys uniform fitting, a fee waiver for South County Youth Soccer's cleat swap events, and a rental request from AAU Warriors Basketball for Rec Center courts on August 15, 2026.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the June 15, 2026 meeting 3-0.
Approved waiving only the non-resident fee for the Charlestown Cowboys uniform fitting event, with future facility rental fees still applying, 3-0.
Approved a fee waiver for South County Youth Soccer's cleat swap events 3-0.
Approved accepting the June 2026 financial reports as presented 3-0.
Approved the rental request from AAU Warriors Basketball for Rec Center Courts 1 and 2 on August 15, 2026, 3-0.
Approved accepting the Divisional reports as presented 3-0.

plain_text:
South Kingstown Recreation Commission 
MEETING MINUTES 
Monday, July 20, 2026 - 6:30 p.m. 
South Kingstown Town Beach 
719 Matunuck Beach Road, Matunuck, RI 
 
A. CALL MEETING TO ORDER 
Meeting was called to order by Commission Chair, J. Hanson at 6:38pm 
B. ROLL CALL 
 
Present: John Hanson, Will Litvin, Matthew Fraza 
Absent: Joanne Blessing 
Staff Present: Jeff Banks, Terry Murphy, Lenka Capek 
Absent:  
Guests: Isabella and Kelly DiGioia, L. Sekscenski, S. Brewer  
 
C. MINUTES OF PREVIOUS MEETING 
A motion was made by Commissioner Litvin and seconded by Commissioner Fraza to approve the 
minutes of the June 15, 2026 meeting. Motion passed 3-0. 
D. CORRESPONDENCE AND PUBLIC COMMENTS 
1. Isabella DeGioia was recognized as the recipient of the *Friends of South Kingstown Parks and 
Recreation Annual Scholarship.  Isabella shared her background with local youth sports and 
volunteering and thanked the Friends of SKPR for the award.  Commission members wished her well 
as she heads off to college. 
 
2. Communications from D. Gray, C. Senecal, and F Ascoli, complimenting the Town on the 4th of July 
Celebration at Old Mountain Field 
 
3. Liz Sekscenski representing the Charlestown Cowboys football and cheer program, requested a fee 
waiver for a uniform fitting held at the recreation center  
Discussion regarding policy implications, potential precedents, and the residency of program 
participants.  Motion by Commissioner Hanson and seconded by Commissioner Fraza to waive only 
the non-resident fee for the recent event, noting that future facility rental fees will still apply. 
Motion passed 3-0. 
 
4. Susanna Brewer from South County Youth Soccer, requested a fee waiver for an upcoming cleat 
swap event. Discussion took place regarding high demand for rental of Rec Center; and availability 
of the Neighborhood Guild for local non-profit organizations that request free use of a room.  Staff 
will review availability of rooms at Rec Center and Guild to provide use at no charge for the two 
cleat swap events.  Motion to approve fee waiver was made by Commissioner Litvin and seconded 
by Commissioner Fraza.  Motion passed 3-0.
E. MONTHLY FINANCIAL REPORT 
The financial report for June 2026 was presented by Director Murphy. A motion to accept the financial 
reports as presented was made by Commissioner Litvin and seconded by Commissioner Fraza. 
Motion passed 3-0. 
F. OLD BUSINESS 
1. Old Mountain Field – Capital Project Status 
Director Murphy reported that progress remains on schedule for October completion. Athletic 
activities and summer camps have gone largely unaffected by the construction activity. 
 
2. Neighborhood Guild Improvement Project – Status Report 
Director reported that the project is substantially complete, with the final steps to include an exterior 
chemical wash of the building in the next month. 
 
G. NEW BUSINESS 
 
1. Request for Rental of Rec Center Courts 1 and 2 on Saturday, August 15, 2026 during non-operating hours, 
by AAU Warriors Basketball, from 11am to 5pm.  It was noted that the applicant would cover the cost of 
staffing for this day.  Total rental cost: $720 ($60 per court per hour).  Motion to approve rental request 
was made by Commissioner Fraza and seconded by Commissioner Litvin.  Motion passed 3-0. 
 
H. DIVISION REPORTS 
 Recreation Division: Supt. Capek reported on June program and Town Beach operations. 
 Parks Division: Supt. Banks reported on June projects and overall work activity of the parks Division. 
A motion to accept the Divisional reports as presented was made by Commissioner Litvin and seconded 
by Commissioner Fraza. Motion passed 3-0. 
I. NEXT MEETING 
The next meeting of the Commission is scheduled for Monday, August 17 , 2026, at 6:30 p.m. at the 
South Kingstown Town Beach. 
J. ADJOURNMENT 
A motion to adjourn was made at 7:50pm by Commissioner Litvin and seconded by Commissioner 
Fraza. Motion passed 3-0.
